name: block-note-native
description: Notion-like block editor for Web + React Native (BlockNote-style), built from scratch on a shared platform-agnostic core. No live collaboration; supports custom blocks & inline content.
author: Sébastien Aglaé

scripts.test: npm run test -w @sebastienaglae/bnn-core && npm run test -w @sebastienaglae/bnn-react
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @sebastienaglae/bnn-core && npm run typecheck -w @sebastienaglae/bnn-react
